description: Intent i003 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=tcp-optwalk-len2) complete. FINDING: net/sched/sch_cake.c cake_get_tcpopt() lines 960-974 is a TCP-option walk that consumes the kind byte ('int opcode = *ptr++;' line 961), handles only EOL/NOP specially ('if (opcode == TCPOPT_NOP) { length--; continue; }' lines 966-969), and then dereferences the size byte 'opsize = *ptr++;' at line 970 with NO 'if (length < 2)' guard — the exact seed mechanism (mptcp_get_options OOB fixed by 'if (length < 2) return'). With attacker-controlled TCP options where th->doff*4-20 leaves length==1 on a non-NOP/EOL trailing byte, the loop reads one byte past the option area. The identical missing guard exists in the mirrored walk cake_tcph_may_drop() at line 1107 ('opsize = *ptr++' after 'int opcode = *ptr++;' line 1098, only 'while (length > 0)' protecting). Untrusted source: packet TCP headers parsed by the CAKE qdisc ACK filter (callers cake_ack_filter lines 1169/1192/1241/1252, with 64-byte skb_header_pointer copies into '_tcph[64]'). opsize is subsequently validated ('opsize < 2 || opsize > length' breaks) so the over-read is bounded to 1 byte; whether it exits the 64-byte stack copy vs the direct skb pointer path was not measured (no kernel build performed), hence confidence=medium. Evidence verified: quote literal in reported range (quote_in_range True). NEGATIVE RESULTS: every other in-tree TCP-option walk in s02 has the >=2-remaining guard or equivalent: tcp_parse_mss_option/tcp_parse_options (net/ipv4/tcp_input.c:3935, 3986), mptcp_get_options (net/mptcp/options.c:359 — seed fix present), nf_conntrack tcp_options/tcp_sack (net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_proto_tcp.c:358, 420), synproxy_parse_options (net/netfilter/nf_synproxy_core.c:53), nf_ct_sack_adjust & synproxy_tstamp_adjust (optoff+1==optend guard, net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_seqadj.c:147), dccp_parse_options (opt_ptr==opt_end check, net/dccp/options.c:76), bpf_search_tcp_opt (opend-op<2 guard, net/core/filter.c:6767), tcp_parse_md5sig_option (loop bounded by length>=TCPOLEN_MD5SIG, net/ipv4/tcp_input.c:4142). Limitations: no KASAN/build confirmation of the cake over-read object boundary; search bounded to net/ via 'opsize = *ptr++', TCPOPT_EOL/NOP walks, and 'while (length > 0)' loops; syncookies.c and tcp_ao.c contain no option walk in this snapshot; mptcp_parse_option sub-option body partially read (belongs to optsize-body-clamp branch).
